features.shared_cleaning: Exact tree_feature_matrices Phase 14 transformation fitted separately within every training partition.

config.hypothesis: Compare logistic regression with the selected Phase 14 booster using exactly the same source columns, codebook cleaning and nested development partitions.

missing_values.method: Shared codebook NaNs followed by train-only fill, scaling and missing indicators for logistic regression; trees retain native NaN routing.

threshold.selection_method: F1-maximizing threshold on inner OOF scores, frozen for each outer evaluation fold

comparison.scope: Conditional on these fitted models, folds and selected thresholds. Does not include retraining or repeated model-selection uncertainty.
